doc.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001

title: Wish list of musicians to record with
summary: She hopes to do duets with Russell Malone and maybe Sonny Rollins and Chick Corea and Gayle.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Are there musicians out there that would be on your wish list to either record with or for you to hire?
Well I just saw Russell Malone downstairs. We were, Bob at Arcadia, Bob Carsey and I were talking about maybe doing a duet album at some point. Not right now but at some
point. And I knew I wanted Russell, to do one with Russell. Another one might be Sonny Rollins. I haven’t talked with him yet though. That would be really fun. I would like that.
He’s kind of a — I’m not sure what word to use — you don’t hear that much from him and then he comes out with another album.
Yeah. He’s great. Another person I really like is the couple Chick and Gayle.
Yeah, I really like them. I’d like to do something with them.
You know, I didn’t even know, are they still together and working.
Well I see them usually here in New York, with some bass with them.
